item.title: What’s new in Svelte: October 2026
item.author: Dani Sandoval
item.description:
SvelteKit 3 is here! Check out the announcement post for the highlights, then run sv migrate to handle most of the upgrade for you.

What’s new in SvelteKit 3

  • Adapters now receive the Svelte config as a function argument (3.0.0-next.27, #16986)
  • Adapters can override getRequest during vite dev

item.title: SvelteKit 3 is here
item.author: The Svelte team
item.description:
Today we’re releasing SvelteKit 3. Upgrading takes one command:

npx sv migrate sveltekit-3
